legend: General Payne has a battalion of n soldiers. The soldiers' beauty contest is coming up, it will last for k days. Payne decided that his battalion will participate in the pageant. Now he has choose the participants.
All soldiers in the battalion have different beauty that is represented by a positive integer. The value ai represents the beauty of the i-th soldier.

On each of k days Generals has to send a detachment of soldiers to the pageant. The beauty of the detachment is the sum of the beauties of the soldiers, who are part of this detachment. Payne wants to surprise the jury of the beauty pageant, so each of k days the beauty of the sent detachment should be unique. In other words, all k beauties of the sent detachments must be distinct numbers.

Help Payne choose k detachments of different beauties for the pageant. Please note that Payne cannot just forget to send soldiers on one day, that is, the detachment of soldiers he sends to the pageant should never be empty.
input: The first line contains two integers n, k (1 ≤ n ≤ 50; 1 ≤ k ≤  ![](https://espresso.codeforces.com/5e54199c623e6698508e30637903d25ae30f0d42.png)) — the number of soldiers and the number of days in the pageant, correspondingly. The second line contains space-separated integers a1, a2, ..., an (1 ≤ ai ≤ 107) — the beauties of the battalion soldiers.
It is guaranteed that Payne's battalion doesn't have two soldiers with the same beauty.
output: Print k lines: in the i-th line print the description of the detachment that will participate in the pageant on the i-th day. The description consists of integer ci (1 ≤ ci ≤ n) — the number of soldiers in the detachment on the i-th day of the pageant and ci distinct integers p1, i, p2, i, ..., pci, i — the beauties of the soldiers in the detachment on the i-th day of the pageant. The beauties of the soldiers are allowed to print in any order.
Separate numbers on the lines by spaces. It is guaranteed that there is the solution that meets the problem conditions. If there are multiple solutions, print any of them.

legend.ai: Payne 将军有一支由 n 名士兵组成的部队。士兵选美比赛即将开始，比赛将持续 k 天。Payne 决定让他的部队参加这场选美比赛。现在他需要选择参赛者。
部队中的所有士兵的美貌各不相同，并且用一个正整数表示。数值 ai 表示第 i 名士兵的美貌。
在接下来的 k 天中，将军每天都必须派遣一支士兵分队参加选美比赛。该分队的美貌等于组成该分队的士兵的美貌之和。Payne 想给选美比赛的评委一个惊喜，因此在这 k 天中的每一天，派出分队的美貌都必须是唯一的。换句话说，派出分队的 k 个美貌值必须是互不相同的数。
帮助 Payne 为选美比赛选出 k 个美貌值各不相同的分队。请注意，Payne 不能在某一天忘记派出士兵，也就是说，他派往选美比赛的士兵分队不应为空。

input.ai: 第一行包含两个整数 n、k(1 ≤ n ≤ 50；1 ≤ k ≤ ![](https://espresso.codeforces.com/5e54199c623e6698508e30637903d25ae30f0d42.png))——士兵的数量和选美比赛的天数。第二行包含 n 个用空格分隔的整数 a1、a2、...、an(1 ≤ ai ≤ 107)——营中士兵的美貌值。
保证 Payne 的营中不存在两名美貌值相同的士兵。

output.ai: 输出 k 行：第 i 行输出将在选美比赛第 i 天参赛的分队描述。描述由一个整数 ci（1 ≤ ci ≤ n）——该分队中的士兵数量，以及 ci 个互不相同的整数 p1,i、p2,i、...、pci,i——该分队中士兵的美貌值组成。士兵的美貌值可以按任意顺序输出。
每行中的数字之间用空格分隔。保证存在满足题目条件的方案。如果有多个方案，输出任意一个即可。
